title: Slow English Podcast #61: United Arab Emirates

sentences.text: Today we will talk about a very interesting country.
This country is called the United Arab Emirates.
Listen carefully and try to understand.
I will speak slowly.
Where is the United Arab Emirates?
The United Arab Emirates, or UAE, is a country in the Middle East.
It is in the southeast of the Arabian Peninsula.
The UAE is next to Saudi Arabia and Oman.
The country is close to the Persian Gulf.
The UAE is made up of seven emirates.
An emirate is like a state.
Each emirate has its own ruler.
The seven emirates are Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umal Kuwait, Ras al -Qaimah and Fajairah.
Abu Dhabi is the largest emirate and it is also the capital of the country.
The capital city of the UAE is Abu Dhabi.
Abu Dhabi is a modern and beautiful city.
It has many tall buildings and big shopping malls.
There are also many parks and gardens in the city.
Abu Dhabi is also home to the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
This mosque is one of the most beautiful in the world.
It is white and has large domes and tall minarets.
Many people visit this mosque to see its beauty and learn about its history.
Another famous city in the UAE is Dubai.
Dubai is the biggest city in the country.
Many tourists visit Dubai every year.
Dubai is known for its modern buildings, luxury hotels and exciting attractions.
The city is always growing and new buildings and projects are built every year.
What is the UAE famous for?
The UAE is famous for its modern cities, luxury hotels and tall buildings.
Dubai has the tallest building in the world.
This building is called the Burj Khalifa.
It is 828 meters high.
Many people visit Dubai to see the Burj Khalifa and enjoy the view from the top.
At night, the building lights up and there is a beautiful fountain show at its base.
The UAE is also famous for its shopping malls.
The Dubai Mall is one of the biggest malls in the world.
It has many shops, restaurants and even an aquarium.
People from different countries come to the UAE to shop.
Another famous shopping place is the Gold Souk.
This is a traditional market in Dubai where people buy gold, jewelry and precious stones.
Another famous place in the UAE is the Palm Jumeirah.
It is a man -made island in the shape of a palm tree.
There are many hotels, beaches and houses on this island.
People can stay in luxury hotels, relax on the beach or eat at fancy restaurants.
The Palm Jumeirah is one of the most unique places in the world.
The UAE is also famous for its cultural and historical sites.
In Sharjah, there are many museums and art galleries.
The Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization has many old books, artifacts and artworks.
It teaches people about the rich history of the Islamic world.
Food in the UAE.
The food in the UAE is very delicious.
People eat a lot of rice, meat and spices.
One popular dish is al mashus.
It is made with rice, meat and special spices.
It has a rich flavor and is a favorite in many homes.
Another famous dish is shawarma.
Shawarma is grilled meat in a sandwich or wrap.
People eat it with garlic sauce and pickles.
It is a very popular street food.
People in the UAE also enjoy sweet desserts.
One popular dessert is lukaimat.
These are small, round and sweet dumplings with honey or syrup.
They are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
Another famous dessert is konferush which is a type of fried cake with saffron and cardamom.
People in the UAE drink a lot of tea and coffee.
Arabic coffee called gawa is very special.
It has a unique taste and people drink it with dates.
Dates are a very popular snack in the UAE.
They are sweet, soft and full of energy.
There are many types of dates and people enjoy them with tea or coffee.
Culture and people.
People in the UAE are very friendly.
They welcome visitors from all over the world.
The main language in the UAE is Arabic but many people also speak English.
The UAE has people from different countries so you can hear many languages in big cities.
The country has many traditions.
One important tradition is falconry.
Falconry is a sport where people train falcons for hunting.
It is a very old and respected tradition in the UAE.
Falcons are very special birds and they are a symbol of strength and pride.
The UAE also has many festivals.
One of the biggest celebrations is National Day.
It happens on December 2nd every year.
People celebrate with fireworks, parades and music.
They decorate their houses, cars and streets with the UAE flag.
Another important celebration is Ramadan.
Ramadan is a holy month when Muslims fast from sunrise to sunset.
At sunset they eat a meal called eftar with their family and friends.
Traditional clothing is also important in the UAE.
Men wear a long white robe called a khandura and women wear a black robe called an abaya.
These clothes are comfortable and protect people from the sun.
Nature and animals.
The UAE has beautiful deserts.
Many people visit the desert for fun activities.
They ride camels, go sandboarding and drive special cars in the sand.
The desert looks very beautiful especially at sunset.
Some people also stay in desert camps and enjoy traditional Emirati food and music.
There are also many animals in the UAE.
Some animals live in the desert like camels, foxes and oryx.
The Arabian oryx is a special animal in the UAE.
It is a white antelope with long horns.
People in the UAE take care of these animals to protect them.
The UAE also has beautiful beaches.
Many tourists visit the beaches to swim, relax and do water sports.
The water is warm and clear.
People enjoy jet skiing scuba diving and fishing.
Fujairah, one of the Emirates, has beautiful coral reefs.
Many people go there to see colorful fish and sea turtles.
There are also mountains in the UAE.
The Hajar mountains are very popular for hiking and camping.
Many people go there to enjoy the fresh air and beautiful views.
Conclusion The United Arab Emirates is a modern and exciting country.
It has amazing cities, delicious food and beautiful nature.
Many tourists visit the UAE to see its famous places and enjoy its culture.
The UAE is a mix of old traditions and new technology.
It is a great place to visit, live and work.
Would you like to visit the UAE one day?
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
